w1lyzp: Ir a + infinitive presents an intention or a plan: voy a reservar. The simple future can express a prediction or a promise: llegaré, tendremos. Add -é, -ás, -á, -emos, -éis, -án to the infinitive. Common stems: tendr-, podr-, har-, dir-, saldr-, vendr-. Practice these forms within near-term plans, without looking for abstract rules about every use.
